nodes.name: Assets/Scripts/Birding/BirdingGame.cs
nodes.summary: The birding minigame HUD. The player charges a frame meter by holding the UseBinoculars input action; on release the frame is caught and bounces to a stop (critically damped spring), then a cursor sweeps across the bird view and the player presses the action again to tag a bird under it. The HUD rotates to track the mouse angle. A legacy joystick-driven rotation variant is preserved in commented-out KEEP blocks.
nodes.languageNotes: Unity new Input System with action-map switching (Player <-> Birding), NUnit Assert validation in Awake, coroutine for game teardown, fixed-timestep state machine.

nodes.name: Assets/Scripts/Birding/BirdingWinFrame.cs
nodes.summary: One-shot 'NICE!' celebration overlay for the birding minigame: shows the tagged bird's icon, plays an animator clip, and deactivates itself when the clip finishes.

nodes.name: Assets/Scripts/Birding/NearbyBirdTracker.cs
nodes.summary: Tracks which BirdBrain instances are within a bird's trigger view range, exposing them as a read-only collection. Keeps the set in sync on trigger enter/exit and on the global BirdBrain.BirdDestroyed event.

nodes.name: Assets/Scripts/Birding/SetBirdingOpacityGradient.cs
nodes.summary: Keeps a birding HUD material's shader property _GradientOriginPosition pinned to an origin transform every frame so the opacity gradient follows the HUD; resets the property to zero on destroy.

nodes.name: Assets/Scripts/BootstrapperConfig.cs
nodes.summary: ScriptableObject asset that declares which prefabs the scene bootstrapper should spawn, grouped by persistence (persistent DontDestroyOnLoad, all scenes, inside scenes, outside scenes).

nodes.name: Assets/Scripts/Buildings/AbandonedShed.cs
nodes.summary: The abandoned shed: an interactable that can be repaired stage by stage (requires a hammer plus materials from the player inventory), serves as an infinite bird perch, and has vines the player chops with an axe that shake via DOTween and, once fully chopped, spawn items and are hidden.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements three project interfaces (BirdBrain.IPerchableHighElevation, InteractInput.IInteractable, Axe.IUseableWithAxe); DOTween DOShakePosition for vine chop feedback.

nodes.name: Assets/Scripts/Buildings/AbandonedShedData.cs
nodes.summary: ScriptableObject holding the shed's shared mutable state: how many repair stages have been done, whether the vines are destroyed, and the names of repaired parts (consumed by the interior to switch visuals).

nodes.name: Assets/Scripts/Buildings/AbandonedShedInterior.cs
nodes.summary: On start, reads the shed data to reflect repairs in the interior: a repaired roof or dry weather disables the rain particles and puddle, a repaired roof disables the roof light, and a repaired floor swaps the sprite.

nodes.name: Assets/Scripts/Characters/DialogueController.cs
nodes.summary: Speech-bubble controller for NPCs: renders one message at a time into a PixelTextRenderer child, holds it for a configurable duration, then fades it out alpha by alpha.

nodes.name: Assets/Scripts/Characters/Gerard.cs
nodes.summary: ScriptableObject tracking Gerard's rescue arc: a three-stage state (UnconsciousBeach, UnconsciousShed, AwakeShed) that advances one step on each player sleep once the ReadyForNextState flag has been set.

nodes.name: Assets/Scripts/Characters/IGiftable.cs
nodes.summary: Declares the IGiftReceiving interface: NPCs that can accept item gifts. It extends UseItemInput.IUsableTarget and requires a TryGiveGift(Inventory.Item) implementation that reports acceptance.
nodes.languageNotes: Interface-only file; the node name differs from the filename (IGiftReceiving declared in IGiftable.cs).

nodes.name: Assets/Scripts/Characters/ShedGerard.cs
nodes.summary: The awake variant of Gerard near the shed. It activates only when Gerard.State is AwakeShed, shows cycling dialogue lines chosen by location (inside/outside) and game hour, and after a couple of outside chats sets ReadyForNextState to progress the arc.

nodes.name: Assets/Scripts/Characters/UnconsciousGerard.cs
nodes.summary: The passed-out Gerard lying on the beach or in the shed. It shows starving flavour dialogue, accepts acceptable food gifts through IGiftReceiving, and once fed enough it reads fed messages, then falls asleep (so only the Narrator comments).

nodes.name: Assets/Scripts/Combat/BasicWeapon.cs
nodes.summary: Defines RangedWeaponItem, a ScriptableObject inventory item for projectile weapons. It holds fire-rate, reload, clip, and a projectile prefab, and exposes per-usage InstanceData (reload/cooldown reactive flags, clip count, spawn transform, target collider). TryFire spawns a pooled projectile aimed at the mouse or a locked-on target.
nodes.languageNotes: ReactiveUnity Reactive<bool> in InstanceData for reload/cooldown state; ObjectPooling for projectile spawn; nested Serializable instance-data class.

nodes.name: Assets/Scripts/Combat/BowChargeController.cs
nodes.summary: Charge-choreography controller for the bow. While charging it locks the player into the Combat action map, fills a HUD frame, tints the frame via MaterialPropertyBlock shader override by charge tier (normal/crit), then on release fires a pooled projectile with speed scaled by charge, applies crit damage and energy cost, and ends with a cooldown gate.
nodes.languageNotes: Input System action-map switching (Player <-> Combat), MaterialPropertyBlock for per-renderer override, ObjectPooling for projectiles, coroutine cooldown gate, Logger.

nodes.name: Assets/Scripts/Combat/ContactHitbox.cs
nodes.summary: Trigger hitbox placed on weapons, projectiles, and enemies that deals damage to anything implementing IHurtBox. Validates targets by layer pairing (enemy hitbox vs friendly hurtbox and vice versa), applies knockback in self/target/both modes, and exposes an OnHit event.
nodes.languageNotes: Layer-name-based target validation, ForceMode2D.Impulse knockback, C# event for hit reporting.

nodes.name: Assets/Scripts/Combat/EnemyActiveWeapon.cs
nodes.summary: Fires a RangedWeaponItem for an enemy: builds the weapon's InstanceData pointing at a target collider and the enemy transform as spawn center, registers it with the Reloader, and calls TryFire every frame while firing is enabled.

nodes.name: Assets/Scripts/Combat/EnemyHealth.cs
nodes.summary: Enemy health component: ReactiveUnity current health initialized to max on enable, TakeDamage with timed invulnerability frames, Heal with clamp, death via Destroy, and a gizmo-drawn health bar for editor visualization.
nodes.languageNotes: ReactiveUnity Reactive<float> CurrentHealth and Reactive<bool> IsInvulnerable; WaitForSeconds coroutine for i-frames.

nodes.name: Assets/Scripts/Combat/EnemyHurtbox.cs
nodes.summary: Trigger collider marking an enemy as damageable: resolves the parent EnemyHealth on enable, exposes vulnerability from its invulnerability flag, and forwards TakeDamage calls to it.

nodes.name: Assets/Scripts/Combat/FlyingChaser.cs
nodes.summary: Flying enemy AI that wanders with steering wander force, detects the player within a view radius with line-of-sight checks, then chases with seek + obstacle avoidance; taking damage makes it permanently aggressive. Gizmos visualize view radius, wander ring, and forces.
nodes.languageNotes: Steering forces (SteeringForces helper) for wander/seek/avoidance; Reactive OnChange subscription to EnemyHealth.CurrentHealth; force-based Rigidbody2D movement.

nodes.name: Assets/Scripts/Combat/IHurtBox.cs
nodes.summary: The damage-receiver contract used across combat: anything with TakeDamage(float) and an IsVulnerable flag can be hit by a ContactHitbox.
nodes.languageNotes: Interface-only file declaring the shared combat damage contract.

nodes.name: Assets/Scripts/Combat/KnockbackMode.cs
nodes.summary: Enumeration of how a ContactHitbox applies knockback: no knockback, knock the hitbox owner, knock the target, or both.

nodes.name: Assets/Scripts/Combat/PlayerActiveWeapon.cs
nodes.summary: Watches the player's active inventory slot via ReactiveUnity; whenever the active item is a RangedWeaponItem, its instance data (with spawn center at the weapon's transform) is handed to the Reloader, and nulled when it is not.

nodes.name: Assets/Scripts/Combat/Projectile.cs
nodes.summary: Pooled projectile that launches at a velocity, dies on lifespan timeout or when it hits a Default-layer collider, and is returned to the pool after hitting a target. Supports a crit variant that doubles the hitbox damage and turns the sprite yellow.
nodes.languageNotes: ObjectPooling.SpawnObject/ReturnObjectToPool lifecycle; subscribes to ContactHitbox.OnHit; coroutine lifespan timeout.

nodes.name: Assets/Scripts/Combat/ProjectileFiringEnemy.cs
nodes.summary: Configurable enemy that keeps the player at a comfortable firing range and executes one of six projectile patterns: single, spread, parallel, burst, aimed (charged, telegraphed red), and ring shot. It idles with wandering, engages with distance-band movement, and becomes permanently aggressive on taking damage.
nodes.languageNotes: Nested FiringPattern/EnemyState enums; coroutines for burst/aimed patterns; ObjectPooling for projectiles; reactive health subscription.

nodes.name: BirdingGame
nodes.summary: MonoBehaviour singleton driving the charging/targeting birding state machine, with mouse alignment, a critically damped frame bounce, cursor sweep, and bird tagging on collision overlap.

nodes.name: BirdingWinFrame
nodes.summary: MonoBehaviour popup that plays a success animation and auto-hides after the clip completes.

nodes.name: NearbyBirdTracker
nodes.summary: MonoBehaviour (requires Collider2D) maintaining a HashSet of nearby BirdBrains, self-excluding, with a debug count field.

nodes.name: SetBirdingOpacityGradient
nodes.summary: MonoBehaviour that writes the gradient origin transform position into a material's vector property each Update.

nodes.name: BootstrapperConfig
nodes.summary: ScriptableObject holding four public GameObject arrays that the bootstrapper uses to populate persistent and per-scene prefabs.

nodes.name: AbandonedShed
nodes.summary: MonoBehaviour tying the shed's repair ladder and vine-clearing to shared AbandonedShedData, with a perch collider for birds and a serialized list of repair stages.

nodes.name: RepairState
nodes.summary: Serializable nested struct-like class describing one shed repair stage: the sprite to show, the inventory item and quantity required, and the repair's display name.

nodes.name: AbandonedShedData
nodes.summary: ScriptableObject with RepairProgress index, AreVinesDestroyed flag, and NamesOfRepaired list.

nodes.name: AbandonedShedInterior
nodes.summary: MonoBehaviour that toggles interior visuals (rain, puddle, roof light, floor sprite) based on AbandonedShedData repair names and the WorldState rain flag.

nodes.name: DialogueController
nodes.summary: MonoBehaviour managing a single in-world text message with a hold duration and per-frame fade, exposed through PostMessage.

nodes.name: Gerard
nodes.summary: ScriptableObject holding Gerard's current state, a ReadyForNextState flag, and a handler advancing the state when the player sleeps.

nodes.name: Gerard.States
nodes.summary: Enum (type: enum) of Gerard's arc positions: passed out on the beach, moved to the shed, awake in the shed.

nodes.name: IGiftReceiving
nodes.summary: Interface (type: interface) extending UseItemInput.IUsableTarget; implementers accept an Inventory.Item gift and return whether it was accepted.

nodes.name: ShedGerard
nodes.summary: MonoBehaviour (implements InteractInput.IInteractable) showing time- and location-appropriate dialogue for the awake shed Gerard and nudging the shared Gerard state forward.

nodes.name: UnconsciousGerard
nodes.summary: MonoBehaviour implementing InteractInput.IInteractable and IGiftReceiving; validates the player's location against Gerard.State, handles gift acceptance, and transitions to sleeping after being fed.

nodes.name: RangedWeaponItem
nodes.summary: Inventory.Item subclass (ScriptableObject) describing a ranged weapon: fire type, rate, reload, clip size, projectile prefab, and a flag for enemy projectiles; implements IInstancedItem<RangedWeaponItem.InstanceData>.

nodes.name: RangedWeaponItem.InstanceData
nodes.summary: Per-instance mutable state for a ranged weapon: spawn center/radius, reactive reload and cooldown flags, elapsed timers, current clip count, and the target collider.

nodes.name: BowChargeController
nodes.summary: MonoBehaviour orchestrating bow charge state (Idle/Charging), HUD visuals, firing, crit detection, energy drain, and the one-frame cooldown between charges.

nodes.name: ContactHitbox
nodes.summary: MonoBehaviour implementing the damage-dealing half of combat: an OnTriggerEnter2D handler that damages valid IHurtBoxes and applies knockback.

nodes.name: EnemyActiveWeapon
nodes.summary: MonoBehaviour (requires Reloader) that configures and continuously fires an enemy's ranged weapon at its assigned target.

nodes.name: EnemyHealth
nodes.summary: MonoBehaviour holding an enemy's max/current health as reactive values, invulnerability gating, damage/heal logic, and a gizmo health bar.

nodes.name: EnemyHurtbox
nodes.summary: MonoBehaviour implementing IHurtBox (type: interface implementation) that adapts the parent EnemyHealth to the IHurtBox damage contract.

nodes.name: FlyingChaser
nodes.summary: MonoBehaviour (requires Rigidbody2D and EnemyHealth) with a Wandering/Chasing state machine driven by steering forces and player detection.

nodes.name: IHurtBox
nodes.summary: Interface (type: interface) declaring TakeDamage(float damage) and a read-only IsVulnerable property.

nodes.name: KnockbackMode
nodes.summary: Enum (type: enum) with None, KnockSelf, KnockTarget, and KnockBoth options.

nodes.name: PlayerActiveWeapon
nodes.summary: MonoBehaviour (requires Reloader) bridging the player's active inventory item to the reloader-driven firing pipeline.

nodes.name: Projectile
nodes.summary: MonoBehaviour (requires Rigidbody2D and SpriteRenderer) wrapping a ContactHitbox child and managing launch, lifespan, crit state, and pool return.

nodes.name: ProjectileFiringEnemy
nodes.summary: MonoBehaviour (requires Rigidbody2D, SpriteRenderer, EnemyHealth) running an Idle/Engaging/Firing state machine with configurable projectile patterns and distance-band behavior.

nodes.name: FiringPattern
nodes.summary: Enum (type: enum) of attack patterns: SingleShot, SpreadShot, ParallelSpread, BurstFire, AimedShot, RingShot.

nodes.name: EnemyState
nodes.summary: Enum (type: enum) of the enemy's AI states: Idle, Engaging, Firing.

nodes.name: Awake
nodes.summary: Sets the singleton instance, caches cursor renderer/collider and the player's PlayerInput, asserts required components, and disables the HUD if it starts active.

nodes.name: Play
nodes.summary: Entry point from the binoculars tool: resets state, configures the Birding action map, pulls charge/cursor velocities from the active Binoculars, aligns HUD rotation to the mouse, and activates the HUD.

nodes.name: HandleState
nodes.summary: Fixed-update state machine: CHARGING advances the frame while the use action is held and ends early if released; TARGETING bounces the frame, moves the cursor, and on action press tags birds or ends the game when the cursor reaches its adjusted limit.

nodes.name: TagAnyBirdsUnderCursor
nodes.summary: Overlaps the cursor collider, plays the miss sound if nothing is hit, otherwise tags the first untagged BirdBrain found (updating its instance data) and logs the species.

nodes.name: MoveCursor
nodes.summary: Advances the targeting cursor along x by the cursor velocity each fixed tick.

nodes.name: BounceFrame
nodes.summary: Eases the frame from its release position toward the stop point using a critically damped spring; snaps it into place once velocity and position are both within tolerance.

nodes.name: GetNextBounceMotionValues
nodes.summary: Pure math helper integrating a critically damped spring (zeta=1, m=1, k=omega^2) one fixed timestep, returning the next position and velocity toward a target.

nodes.name: EnterTargetingState
nodes.summary: Switches to TARGETING: shows the cursor, clamps the frame stop point, and maps the frame's charge completion into the cursor's max travel limit so shorter charges yield shorter cursor sweeps.

nodes.name: FixedUpdate
nodes.summary: Aligns the HUD to the mouse every fixed tick, skips one tick after an action-map switch (input misfire workaround), then runs HandleState.

nodes.name: AlignHUDToMousePosition
nodes.summary: Rotates the HUD so it always faces the current mouse position in world space.

nodes.name: ConfigureControls
nodes.summary: Switches the player to the Birding action map and grabs the UseBinoculars action, asserting it exists.

nodes.name: ResetGameState
nodes.summary: Resets the minigame: hides the cursor, zeroes charge/bounce/flag fields, and returns the frame and cursor to their start positions.

nodes.name: GetParametersFromBinoculars
nodes.summary: Derives frame charge velocity and cursor sweep velocity from the active Binoculars' ChargeTimeSecs and CursorTimeSecs.

nodes.name: EndGame
nodes.summary: Coroutine that logs completion, switches the player back to the Player action map, deactivates the HUD, and returns the player to the Idle state.

nodes.name: PlayWin
nodes.summary: Activates the win frame, sets the bird icon sprite, and starts the coroutine that waits for the NICE! clip to finish.

nodes.name: WaitForAnimationToEnd
nodes.summary: Coroutine that plays the named clip and yields until its normalized time reaches 1, then deactivates the frame.

nodes.name: Start
nodes.summary: Caches the owning BirdBrain and view collider, forces the collider to be a trigger, and seeds the set with currently overlapping birds.

nodes.name: InitializeNearbyBirds
nodes.summary: Overlaps the view range and adds every overlapping non-self BirdBrain to the nearby set.

nodes.name: OnEnable
nodes.summary: Subscribes to the BirdBrain.BirdDestroyed static event.

nodes.name: OnDisable
nodes.summary: Unsubscribes from the BirdBrain.BirdDestroyed static event.

nodes.name: OnTriggerEnter2D
nodes.summary: Adds a non-self bird that enters the view range to the nearby set.

nodes.name: OnTriggerExit2D
nodes.summary: Removes a bird that leaves the view range from the nearby set.

nodes.name: OnBirdDestroyed
nodes.summary: Removes a destroyed bird from the set and sweeps out any stale null entries.

nodes.name: Start
nodes.summary: Asserts the origin transform and material are assigned and that the material has the _GradientOriginPosition property.

nodes.name: Update
nodes.summary: Sets the material's _GradientOriginPosition vector to the current origin transform position.

nodes.name: OnDestroy
nodes.summary: Resets the material's _GradientOriginPosition to zero so the gradient does not linger after the HUD is gone.

nodes.name: Start
nodes.summary: Caches renderer/collider and perch bounds, sets the sprite to the current repair progress stage, and hides or re-layers the vines depending on the shed data.

nodes.name: GetPositionTarget
nodes.summary: Returns a random point inside the perch collider, resampling until the point actually overlaps it - used by birds to land on the shed roof.

nodes.name: GetSortingOrder
nodes.summary: Exposes the renderer sorting order so birds can draw above or below the roof correctly.

nodes.name: CursorInteract
nodes.summary: Interact handler: blocks interaction while vines remain, then checks the player holds the hammer (else hints via PlayerDialogue) and has the required materials (else hints quantity needed) before advancing repair progress, swapping the sprite, and narrating the repair.

nodes.name: OnUseAxe
nodes.summary: Axe interaction: counts a vine chop, shakes the vines, and once enough chops accumulate marks vines destroyed, spawns drop items from the collider, and hides the vines.

nodes.name: ShakeVines
nodes.summary: DOTween position-shakes the vines transform using the serialized shake duration, strength, vibrato, and randomness.

nodes.name: Start
nodes.summary: Evaluates roof/floor repair names and the current rain state, then disables the rain system/puddle, roof light, and swaps the floor sprite accordingly.

nodes.name: Start
nodes.summary: Resolves the PixelTextRenderer from children and records the parent transform to follow.

nodes.name: Update
nodes.summary: Holds the current message until the duration elapses, then fades its alpha each frame and clears the text at zero.

nodes.name: PostMessage
nodes.summary: Sets the text renderer's message at full opacity and restarts the hold timer.

nodes.name: OnEnable
nodes.summary: Subscribes to the global SleepMenu.PlayerSlept event.

nodes.name: OnDisable
nodes.summary: Unsubscribes from the global SleepMenu.PlayerSlept event.

nodes.name: OnPlayerSleep
nodes.summary: Advances Gerard one stage per sleep when ReadyForNextState is true (UnconsciousBeach -> UnconsciousShed -> AwakeShed), clearing the flag each time.

nodes.name: Awake
nodes.summary: Hides or destroys this object unless Gerard is in the AwakeShed state, then toggles visibility by whether the current game hour falls inside the active day window for this location.

nodes.name: CursorInteract
nodes.summary: Interact handler that posts an inside or outside message depending on the flagged location.

nodes.name: PostInsideMessage
nodes.summary: Cycles through the inside dialogue list, then falls back to random general lines.

nodes.name: PostOutsideMessage
nodes.summary: Cycles the outside dialogue list and, after the second outside line, sets Gerard.ReadyForNextState so the arc can progress.

nodes.name: Awake
nodes.summary: Shows this variant only when Gerard.State matches the scene location (beach vs shed) and the date is past the first spring; caches the DialogueController.

nodes.name: TryGiveGift
nodes.summary: Gift handler: refuses and posts a fed message if asleep/already ready, accepts and sets ReadyForNextState if the gift is in the acceptable-food list, otherwise declines with a 'not what I need' line.

nodes.name: CursorInteract
nodes.summary: Interact handler that posts a random starving message, or the after-fed/sleep message once the arc has progressed.

nodes.name: PostAfterFedMessage
nodes.summary: Posts either a narrator 'He's asleep' line when asleep, or cycles the fed-thanks lines until exhausted, at which point the character falls asleep.

nodes.name: CreateInstanceData
nodes.summary: Factory that builds a fresh InstanceData from the weapon's serialized clip size and default reactive flags.

nodes.name: OnEnable
nodes.summary: Asserts the weapon's clip size, fire rate, and projectile prefab are configured.

nodes.name: TryFire
nodes.summary: Fires if not reloading or cooling down: executes the fire method, starts the cooldown, decrements the clip, and flips to reloading when the clip empties.

nodes.name: ExecuteFireMethod
nodes.summary: Dispatches to the weapon's fire method by FireType (currently only SingleShot).

nodes.name: FireSingleShot
nodes.summary: Spawns the projectile from the pool at the spawn center offset by the spawn radius toward the aim point (mouse or target collider), rotates it, and calls Launch.

nodes.name: Awake
nodes.summary: Locates the player and caches PlayerCarry, PlayerInput, PlayerEnergyManager, PlayerMovement; caches frame renderers and hides the HUD.

nodes.name: StartCharge
nodes.summary: Public entry from the bow tool: rejects if charging, blocked, or carrying; switches to the Combat map, computes charge velocity from the bow, resets frame visuals, optionally locks the player into BowCharging state.

nodes.name: Update
nodes.summary: While charging: aligns the pivot to the mouse, advances the frame while the use action is held, fires at max charge or on release above the minimum, else cancels; updates frame alpha and override color each frame.

nodes.name: Fire
nodes.summary: Resolves energy affordability, spawns and launches a pooled projectile aimed at the mouse with charge-scaled speed, marks crits, drains energy, decrements the clip/reload, then ends the charge.

nodes.name: EndCharge
nodes.summary: Cleans up the charge: hides the HUD, resets frame alpha and shader override, restores the player's Idle state if locked, resets the pivot, returns to the Player action map, and starts the one-frame cooldown.

nodes.name: ChargeCooldown
nodes.summary: Coroutine that blocks the next charge for a single frame to prevent instant re-triggers.

nodes.name: SetFrameAlpha
nodes.summary: Applies an alpha to every frame sprite renderer.

nodes.name: SetOverride
nodes.summary: Sets a MaterialPropertyBlock on every frame renderer with override color and percent shader properties.

nodes.name: ClearOverride
nodes.summary: Clears the MaterialPropertyBlock from every frame renderer, restoring default material color.

nodes.name: UpdateOverrideColor
nodes.summary: Colors the charge frame white while ramping to the crit window, solid yellow inside the crit window, and clears it past the crit window.

nodes.name: AlignPivotToMouse
nodes.summary: Rotates the bow pivot transform to face the mouse position in world space.

nodes.name: AbortCharge
nodes.summary: Public cancel entry point that ends the charge if one is active.

nodes.name: Awake
nodes.summary: Caches the parent Rigidbody2D and resolves the friendly/enemy hitbox and hurtbox layer indices.

nodes.name: OnTriggerEnter2D
nodes.summary: On trigger overlap: skips invalid or invulnerable hurtboxes, otherwise deals damage, applies knockback, and raises the OnHit event.

nodes.name: IsValidTarget
nodes.summary: Checks that the overlapping collider's layer matches this hitbox's side: enemy hitbox only hits friendly hurtbox, friendly hitbox only enemy hurtbox.

nodes.name: ApplyKnockback
nodes.summary: Applies an impulse knockback according to the configured KnockbackMode: self, target, both, or none.

nodes.name: GetTargetRb
nodes.summary: Resolves the rigidbody to knock back from the hurtbox collider, preferring a parent rigidbody.

nodes.name: DoKnockback
nodes.summary: Static helper that pushes a rigidbody away from a source position with an impulse force.

nodes.name: Start
nodes.summary: Creates the weapon instance data, wires the target collider and spawn transform, and hands the weapon to the Reloader.

nodes.name: Update
nodes.summary: Fires the weapon every frame while the _isFiring flag is set.

nodes.name: OnEnable
nodes.summary: Resets current health to max whenever the enemy is enabled (pool-spawn friendly).

nodes.name: TakeDamage
nodes.summary: Applies positive damage if not invulnerable, logs the attacker from the stack trace, kills the enemy at zero health, otherwise starts invulnerability frames.

nodes.name: InvulnerabilityFrames
nodes.summary: Coroutine that flips IsInvulnerable on, waits the configured duration, then flips it off.

nodes.name: Heal
nodes.summary: Adds a positive heal amount, clamped to max health.

nodes.name: Die
nodes.summary: Logs the death and destroys the enemy GameObject.

nodes.name: OnEnable
nodes.summary: Caches the parent EnemyHealth and asserts it exists.

nodes.name: TakeDamage
nodes.summary: Forwards damage to the parent EnemyHealth.TakeDamage.

nodes.name: Awake
nodes.summary: Caches the rigidbody and EnemyHealth and subscribes to CurrentHealth changes to detect taking damage.

nodes.name: GetPlayer
nodes.summary: Lazily finds the player by tag and caches the PlayerHurtbox transform as the chase target.

nodes.name: Start
nodes.summary: Initializes the wander target and resolves interaction layers for avoidance from the steering helper.

nodes.name: Update
nodes.summary: Periodically re-detects the player: transitions to Chasing when within view radius with no obstacle linecast, and back to Wandering when the player leaves (unless already aggressive).

nodes.name: FixedUpdate
nodes.summary: Runs the wander or chase behavior based on the current state.

nodes.name: UpdateWandering
nodes.summary: Refreshes the steering wander force on an interval, adds the wander plus avoidance force, and clamps velocity to wander speed.

nodes.name: UpdateChasing
nodes.summary: Applies a seek force toward the player plus avoidance, clamped to chase speed.

nodes.name: OnHealthChanged
nodes.summary: Reactive health callback that flips the chaser aggressive and enters Chasing the first time it takes damage.

nodes.name: OnEnable
nodes.summary: Subscribes to the inventory's ActiveItemSlot reactive and re-resolves the active weapon.

nodes.name: OnDisable
nodes.summary: Runs all stored unsubscription hooks to detach from the inventory reactive.

nodes.name: SetActiveWeapon
nodes.summary: Reads the active inventory item; clears the reloader weapon if not a ranged weapon, otherwise hands it the RangedWeaponItem with its InstanceData and assigns the spawn center/radius.

nodes.name: Awake
nodes.summary: Caches the rigidbody, sprite renderer, and child ContactHitbox, stores base damage, and subscribes to the hitbox's OnHit event.

nodes.name: OnDestroy
nodes.summary: Unsubscribes from the hitbox's OnHit event.

nodes.name: OnTriggerEnter2D
nodes.summary: Disables the projectile when it overlaps a Default-layer collider (terrain/walls).

nodes.name: Launch
nodes.summary: Starts the lifespan timeout and sets the rigidbody velocity to the direction times speed and an optional speed multiplier.

nodes.name: SetCrit
nodes.summary: Toggles crit state: yellow sprite and doubled hitbox damage when crit, white and base damage otherwise.

nodes.name: OnHitTarget
nodes.summary: Hit event handler that disables the projectile once it lands a hit.

nodes.name: DisableProjectileAfterLifespan
nodes.summary: Coroutine that waits the lifespan then disables the projectile.

nodes.name: DisableProjectile
nodes.summary: Stops the lifespan coroutine, zeroes velocity, resets crit, and returns the projectile to the object pool.

nodes.name: Awake
nodes.summary: Caches the rigidbody, sprite renderer, and EnemyHealth, records the original color, and subscribes to health changes.

nodes.name: Start
nodes.summary: Finds the player by tag, caches the PlayerHurtbox transform, and picks an initial wander target.

nodes.name: Update
nodes.summary: Runs periodic detection and, while Firing, drives the firing pattern logic.

nodes.name: FixedUpdate
nodes.summary: Runs the movement behavior matching the current state (idle wander, engage, or hold position while firing).

nodes.name: HandleDetection
nodes.summary: Periodically checks line of sight to the player within the approach radius to enter Engaging, and returns to Idle when the player is lost and the enemy is not aggressive.

nodes.name: PickNewWanderTarget
nodes.summary: Picks a random point within the wander radius around the current position as the new idle destination.

nodes.name: StopIdleWait
nodes.summary: Cancels an in-progress idle wait coroutine and clears the waiting flag.

nodes.name: UpdateIdleMovement
nodes.summary: Drifts toward the wander target at idle speed and, on arrival, starts the idle wait coroutine.

nodes.name: IdleWaitCoroutine
nodes.summary: Halts movement for a random wait duration, then picks a new wander target.

nodes.name: UpdateEngagingMovement
nodes.summary: Moves toward the player at engage speed, retreats if inside the retreat radius, and enters Firing when inside the firing band.

nodes.name: UpdateFiringMovement
nodes.summary: Holds position while firing and drops back to Engaging when the player gets too close or too far.

nodes.name: HandleFiring
nodes.summary: Gates on the fire rate and whether a firing coroutine is already active, then executes the configured pattern.

nodes.name: ExecuteFiringPattern
nodes.summary: Dispatches to the pattern-specific fire method, starting coroutines for burst and aimed shots.

nodes.name: StopActiveFireCoroutine
nodes.summary: Cancels an in-flight burst/aimed coroutine, clears the active flag, and restores the sprite color.

nodes.name: GetDirectionToPlayer
nodes.summary: Returns the normalized direction from the enemy to the player.

nodes.name: SpawnAndLaunchProjectile
nodes.summary: Spawns a pooled projectile at the spawn offset, orients it, launches it with speed/damage multipliers, and boosts the hitbox damage when the damage multiplier exceeds one.

nodes.name: FireSingleShot
nodes.summary: Launches a single projectile aimed at the player.

nodes.name: FireSpreadShot
nodes.summary: Launches a fan of projectiles across a configurable angle around the player direction.

nodes.name: FireParallelSpread
nodes.summary: Launches a line of parallel projectiles perpendicular to the aim direction at a given spacing.

nodes.name: BurstFireCoroutine
nodes.summary: Coroutine that fires N aimed shots at a fixed interval, blocking other firing while active.

nodes.name: AimedShotCoroutine
nodes.summary: Coroutine that telegraphs with a red sprite while stationary for the charge duration, then fires a faster, harder-hitting aimed shot.

nodes.name: FireRingShot
nodes.summary: Fires a full 360-degree ring of projectiles.

nodes.name: OnHealthChanged
nodes.summary: Reactive health callback that marks the enemy aggressive and jumps from Idle to Engaging on first damage.

edges.description: RepairState is a nested type of AbandonedShed.
States is a nested type of Gerard.
InstanceData is a nested type of RangedWeaponItem.
FiringPattern is a nested enum of ProjectileFiringEnemy.
EnemyState is a nested enum of ProjectileFiringEnemy.
EnemyHurtbox implements the IHurtBox damage contract.
UnconsciousGerard implements the IGiftReceiving gift interface.
Play resets minigame state before configuring.
Play switches to the Birding action map.
Play derives velocities from the active binoculars.
Play orients the HUD toward the mouse.
FixedUpdate keeps the HUD aligned each tick.
FixedUpdate drives the game state machine.
Targeting state bounces the frame to its stop point.
Targeting state tags birds on action press.
Targeting state ends the game on tag or cursor limit.
BounceFrame integrates the damped spring each tick.
PlayWin waits for the win clip to finish.
Start seeds the set with birds already in range.
Inside interactions post the inside message.
Outside interactions post the outside message.
Gift handler posts the fed/asleep line when appropriate.
Interact posts the fed/asleep line once the arc progresses.
TryFire dispatches to the fire method.
Update keeps the pivot aimed at the mouse while charging.
Update fires at full charge or on release above minimum.
Update cancels the charge below the minimum.
Update fades the frame with charge progress.
Update recolors the frame by charge tier.
StartCharge begins with a hidden frame.
Fire always ends the charge afterward.
EndCharge resets frame alpha to zero.
EndCharge starts the one-frame cooldown gate.
Charge tiers clear the override past the crit window.
Target knockback resolves the target rigidbody.
Landing a hit disables the projectile.
Start picks an initial wander target.
Update drives firing while in the Firing state.
Engaging state moves by distance bands.
Detection cancels an in-flight fire pattern.
Detection picks a new wander target on reset.
Reaching the target starts an idle wait.
Leaving the firing band cancels the pattern.
Fire-rate gating then executes the pattern.
Each burst shot spawns a projectile.
Aimed shot spawns a boosted projectile.
Spread base angle uses the player direction.
Each spread angle spawns a projectile.
Each parallel lane spawns a projectile.
Each ring angle spawns a projectile.
ShedGerard reads Gerard.State for visibility and sets ReadyForNextState.
UnconsciousGerard reads and sets Gerard.State / ReadyForNextState.
EnemyHurtbox forwards damage to the parent EnemyHealth.
FlyingChaser subscribes to EnemyHealth.CurrentHealth for aggression.
ProjectileFiringEnemy subscribes to EnemyHealth.CurrentHealth for aggression.
ProjectileFiringEnemy spawns and launches Projectile instances.
Projectile subscribes to its child ContactHitbox.OnHit event.
Projectile's OnHitTarget consumes the IHurtBox hit payload.
ContactHitbox resolves IHurtBox components and calls TakeDamage.
ContactHitbox branches on the shared KnockbackMode enum.
FireSingleShot spawns and launches Projectile instances.
BowChargeController reads RangedWeaponItem config and InstanceData.
BowChargeController spawns and launches Projectile instances.
EnemyActiveWeapon builds RangedWeaponItem instance data and fires it.
PlayerActiveWeapon casts the active item to RangedWeaponItem and its InstanceData.
